headline: Small SE windswell, glassy at dawn — log it before the sea breeze fills in.
today: Waist-high at best on a decent SE angle, and the morning is the move: NW then WNW keeps it light and clean through the low around 7am. Log or groveler, work the incoming tide before the H at 1:28p. Afternoon S wind goes onshore and 9mph-plus by lunch, so it junks up after — dawn patrol or bust.

daysToWatch.note: Swell jumps to 3ft-plus on a prime ESE angle at up to 9.8s, but E cross wind blows 15mph all day. Size is there, cleanliness isn't.
Still 2.5ft with a good SE angle and much lighter wind — dawn E cross at 6mph and a softer morning. The cleaner of the weekend days here.
